CRAFT

LEATHER / MATERIAL

For the Friday departure and the invitation that becomes a weekend away. The Eleanor has the presence of a travel bag with the considered details of a favorite handbag: rolled handles, a broad leather flap and a generous silhouette. It feels as natural beside a wool coat as it does at the end of a sunlit platform.
